title: The density of sums of distinct divisors
summary: For a positive integer $t$, let $d_t$ denote the natural density of the set of $n$ for which $t$ is a sum of distinct divisors of $n$. Erdős proved that $d_t$ exists, gave an unspecified polylogarithmic upper bound, asserted without proof a matching lower bound, and asked whether $d_t \sim c_3/(\log t)^{c_4}$. We record the explicit bounds \[ ν_t \le d_t \ll \frac{(\log\log t)^{δ-3/2}}{(\log t)^δ}, \qquad ν_t = \frac{K}{\log t}\Bigl(1 + O\Bigl(\frac{\log\log t}{\log t}\Bigr)\Bigr), \] where $δ= 0.086071\ldots$ is the Erdős--Ford--Tenenbaum constant, $K=c\,e^{-γ}$, and $c=1.33607\ldots$ is…
